title: Día de los Muertos events in South Florida Nov. 1 and 2
igCaption:
Día de los Muertos falls on Nov. 1 and 2. Here’s where South Florida is marking it.
Nov. 1 and 2, Miami Beach, Doral and Fort Lauderdale

Sources: Boca Raton Observer, Islander News, Sun Sentinel, WLRN, Out South Florida, AP News

#MiamiEvents #Doral #MiamiBeach #FortLauderdale

scenes.text: Día de los Muertos lands on November 1 and 2. South Florida has events in Miami Beach, Doral and Fort Lauderdale tied to it.
Start on Miami Beach. The Goodtime Hotel has Goodtime Sundays: Day of the Dead Pool Party on November 1.
scenes.caption: Start on Miami Beach. The Goodtime Hotel has Goodtime Sundays: Day of the Dead Pool Party on Nov. 1.

scenes.text: In Doral, CityPlace Doral is hosting its fifth annual Día de los Muertos celebration.
scenes.caption: In Doral, CityPlace Doral is hosting its 5th annual Día de los Muertos celebration.

scenes.text: Fort Lauderdale also has a Day of the Dead celebration. The Sun Sentinel covered its return with photos. If you go, check NEAR to see who else was at the altar.
scenes.caption: Fort Lauderdale also has a Day of the Dead celebration. The Sun Sentinel covered its return with photos. If you go, check NEAR to see who else was at the altar.

scenes.text: Miami has another layer to this weekend. WLRN covered Haiti’s Day of the Dead in Miami, centered on spirituality and community.
